entry.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: detailed colored completion illustration for the Picross hand-drawn album game. Primary request: Filipino Chicken Adobo, clearly recognizable cooked bone-in chicken pieces coated in rich dark soy-vinegar brown glaze, identifiable chicken drumstick silhouette, cooked garlic cloves, two olive-green bay leaves, a few visible black peppercorns. Quiet warm hand-drawn 2D editorial food illustration with confident clean dark-brown contours, substantial rich colored shapes, controlled interior drawing, subtle natural brush texture and restrained shading. Detailed and appetizing, not photorealistic, not 3D, not pixel art and not simplified to a grid. Main shapes must remain distinct enough for a later small color nonogram, around 25 rows; do NOT draw a puzzle, cells or clues. Render one complete centered composition with comfortable clear margin, no clipping, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no frame. Genuine transparent PNG exterior, no white or cream rectangular backdrop, no checkerboard drawing, no table or decorative props, no detached ground shadow. Keep white ceramic and white rice as opaque parts of the motif, not transparent. The illustration should be richly finished and colorful independently of any later puzzle palette. No unrelated food or garnish, no chili, tomato or broccoli.
Variant B: a compact deep muted teal ceramic bowl with a broad simple rim, viewed from a high three-quarter angle, no rice. Four clearly separated golden-brown glazed chicken portions in dark glossy sauce, one prominent drumstick at front-right, a wing and two thighs behind it. Large readable warm amber chicken surfaces with dark caramel edges. Two bay leaves and three chunky cooked garlic cloves in the sauce; a few restrained peppercorns. The teal bowl creates a rounded cupped silhouette and a visible curved front wall; no handles. Strong visual hierarchy, a compact food portrait approximately as wide as tall.
